_note: Neutral HUD look shared by every world (src/ui/hud_style.gd, src/ui/hud_kit.gd): crypt, Hell-Dungeon and Frostgruft draw the same panels, text and bars, never in a world's own colours. Colours are hex (RRGGBB or RRGGBBAA); sizes in screen px at 1280x720.
_life_note: The life bar of the hero strip (HudKit.life_bar): bar_width / bar_height in px (287 = the old row of ten hearts), badge_height = the level badge beside it. blood_lite is the bar's 1 px top edge and its drifting highlights, blood_glow the pulsing glow. life_ghost_hold / life_ghost_time / life_heal_sweep in seconds (how long the lost chunk stays lit, how long it takes to shrink away, how long the heal light takes to cross the bar); life_pulse_hz / life_low_pulse_hz / life_wobble_hz in cycles per second (the glow's pulse, the pulse when life is low, the surface's wobble); life_low_share = the life share (0..1) below which the bar pulses hard and its frame turns red; life_hit_threshold = the loss in half hearts within one frame that counts as a hit (smaller losses are a drain and just slide).
_pet_note: The companion bar under the hero strip (HudKit.pet_panel): pet_row_height = the row in px, pet_pad its inner margin, pet_portrait the portrait slot (the idle frame sits in it at 1x or 2x, whichever fits), pet_slot / pet_icon / pet_slot_gap the two ability slots on the right with their talent icon (18 px tile, 36 = 2x), pet_bar_height the companion's life bar, pet_key_size the key label (5, 6), pet_number_size the cooldown seconds. pet_portraits: companion kind (talents.json pet.kinds) -> idle frame; a missing file or kind falls back to a drawn glyph. auto = the auto-cast marker's colour (the skill bar's running glow).

colors._map_base_note: map_base: the opaque ground under the floor panel (mini-map) and the boss bar's subtitle plate, so nothing of the world shows through.
colors._mob_bar_note: mob_bar: the small health bar over a hurt monster in the story worlds (src/hell/hell_game.gd); mob_bar_burn / mob_bar_poison / mob_bar_bleed: the same bar while that damage over time runs on it (src/hell/hero_kit.gd dot_kind; poison and bleed in the talents' poison and blood tones, src/vfx/talent_palette.gd).

_inventory_note: The inventory window in the story worlds (src/ui/inventory_panel.gd fit_below, src/hell/hell_game.gd): its top sits inventory_gap px below the hero strip and the companion bar, so it never covers them at 1280x720; its bottom goes down to inventory_bottom (screen px, clear of the resource label over the skill bar, which starts at about 628); its equipment column closes up to a slot every inventory_equip_step_min px at least (a 60 px slot and its 16 px label).
_compact_note: compact_bar_width: px of the life bar in the slim story hero strip (hud_kit.gd hero_compact); story_minimap 0 hides the corner mini-map in the story worlds (map on M and in the pause), 1 shows it.

rules._note: What the story worlds' HUD shows when (src/ui/hud_kit.gd HudKit.rule; user rule: the player sees what matters, nothing else). Seconds: toast_time each toast stays (one at a time, the rest wait), toast_in / toast_fade its fade in / out, toast_queue how many may wait, toast_max_width px before it wraps to two lines; banner_time the room banner's whole life (new rooms and floors only), banner_in / banner_out its fades; resource_hold the quiet time before the resource row (keys, rune stones, braziers) fades over resource_fade; inventory_chip_hold how long the INVENTAR chip shows after the bag changed. Alphas 0..1: pet_idle_alpha the companion bar at full life with no cooldown, floor_calm_alpha the floor panel outside fights, menu_chip_alpha the ESC chip when the mouse is away. resource_label_size px of the MANA / AUSDAUER / ZORN label, resource_low_share the share under which its numbers show without hover.
rules._toast_merge_note: toast_merge: s a shown find toast still takes more finds into one line ("3 Funde: ..."); a waiting one always does.

gefuege._note: The Leerenmagier's Arkanes Gefüge beside his mana (src/ui/talent_bar.gd draw_gefuege), screen px: radius of the orb, cell the pixel size of its art (one unit = one cell), gap between the mana bar's end and the orb, lift of its centre from the bar's top, glow dither coverage of the violet rim glow, pulse_time s of the pulse when units enter, burst_time s and burst_speed px/s of the burst when it empties, orbit_speed rad/s of the outer orbit (inner ones faster), squash of the orbits, core cells of the tiny core. tone: the ramp step (src/vfx/talent_palette.gd, 0 deep .. 4 spec; default 3 lite) a unit of that element is drawn in.
